· Below SMA100/200 ($115.74/$116.15): maintaining long-term weak trend strength.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.6→39.5) + entering oversold territory, maintaining bearish momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1165→-0.1165) + holding steady, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $108.52) + 7.48% band width indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($110.46) + based on price pattern.
· Swing resistance ($113.67) + potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low, range-bound) + lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.01x 5-day average) + moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + entry conditions not met, maintaining wait-and-see stance.
